rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"TypeCollector now wraps the analyzer's diagnostic callback so that a diagnostic is reported only if its location is in source inside the compilation being analyzed. Two places that built a diagnostic location from a member declaration no longer index DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]: one now uses FirstOrDefault and the other a new null-safe helper, GetPropertyIdentifierLocation. Separately, the key-attributed property branch flips the accessibility test that sets nonPublicMembersAreSerialized from != Public to == Public. New tests compile a defining assembly to a metadata-only image and check that a closed generic struct or record struct from it builds without diagnostics and still gets a resolver.
